item.title: IGN Gives Ghost of Yotei Lower Score Than Dragon Age Veilguard, Critics Call It 'Better Than Tsushima' But Fans See 'Disaster Coming'
item.description: The reviews for Ghost of Yōtei, the much-anticipated follow-up to Ghost of Tsushima, landed this week with a chorus of near-universal acclaim.
